answer: A random beacon spot-check plus a compute heartbeat blocks bulk fakes. Each epoch the beacon samples agents at random, and a falcon-fast verifier demands a heartbeat: proof of real work this hour. One machine cannot serve two identities, so a missed check forfeits bond and seat. A gale of 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 machines at 0.5 POA each, so the farm pays 500 POA a round for nothing. One honest agent pays once and earns its full share.
